what: the MHz-per-kLUT curve, re-measured. Area and frequency come from the SAME build for every row, so they cannot drift apart the way the old curve did.
why_the_old_one_was_unrecoverable: every Fmax on record was paired with a FOLDED area -- gft_sadd 18.24 MHz measured on 1312 LUT against an honest 4304, gft_signed_mac 9.14 on 6466 against 9505. There was no honest (area, frequency) pair anywhere in the corpus, so the curve could not be recomputed, only re-measured.

fit.reading: a power law. Doubling the area costs 34 % of the frequency.

residual_note: gft_train1 sits at 0.67x the law and gft_sadd at 1.38x -- a factor of two either side. Structure matters beyond size, which is the same thing T846 measured about place-and-route TIME. Both are properties of the cone, not of the LUT count.
carry4_omitted: the CARRY4 column parses to values above the LUT count (1604 where the yosys line reads 160). It is not part of the curve, and publishing a number I cannot explain would be worse than omitting it.
xorpercep: running separately -- its build hung for 74 minutes with no child process and no CPU after nextpnr exited, and was killed so the loop could finish. Re-running alone.
